findings.claim: The enforcement-registry rewrite asserts, in the present tense, that the new run_mode key is already "read by aid-run-gates.sh", but at this commit aid-run-gates.sh has no resolver/validator for run_mode at all — Step 1 (this step) only creates the config field/docs, and the read/consumption is explicitly deferred to Step 2 per the new test file's own header comment.
findings.fix: Word the registry sentence in future/planned tense for the read path (e.g. "execution.yaml now carries the field; Step 2 wires aid-run-gates.sh to read it") instead of asserting present-tense behaviour that does not exist yet in this repository at this commit.
